edition_notes: USAopoly (The Op), Copyright 2025, Ruleset Edition 3.1; designed by Eric Olsen; 3+ players, ages 8+, 20 min.

items.rule: Shuffle the 94-card deck thoroughly and choose a player to be the Dealer for the round; keep a pen and paper to track scores.
The Dealer deals one card face up to each player in turn order, including themself.
If an Action card comes up during the initial deal, pause dealing immediately to resolve it, then continue dealing until everyone has been dealt a card.
On their turn, an active player chooses to Hit (get dealt another card) or Stay (exit the round and bank their points); the Dealer offers this choice to each player in turn.
Number cards go in a single row in front of the player, with Score Modifier cards placed above them; Action cards are set above the Number cards.
A player may Stay only if they have at least one card in front of them.
Bust: if a player draws a second Number card with the same number as one already in their line, they bust, are out of the round and score nothing for it.
An active player is one who has not busted or stayed; inactive players flip their cards over until the round ends.
Action cards can be played on any active player including yourself; if you are the only active player you must play it on yourself.
Freeze: the player receiving it banks all points collected and is out of the round.
Flip Three: the receiving player must accept the next three cards, flipping them one at a time, stopping early if they bust or achieve Flip 7.
During Flip Three, Number, Action and Modifier cards all count toward the three cards.
If a Flip Three reveals another Flip Three or Freeze, it is resolved only AFTER all three cards are drawn and only if the player has not busted; a revealed Second Chance may be set aside and used.
Second Chance: the player keeps it; if they are dealt a duplicate number, discard both the Second Chance and the duplicate card instead of busting.
A player may hold only one Second Chance; if dealt another, they give it to another active player who has none, or discard it if no one can take it.
All Second Chance cards are discarded at the end of a round even if unused.
Modifier cards are not Number cards, don't count toward Flip 7, and cannot cause a bust; a player may end with only a Modifier and still score it (unless it is x2).
A round ends when there are no active players (all busted or stayed), or when one player gets 7 unique Number cards (Flip 7), ending the round immediately for everyone.
The game ends at the end of a round in which at least one player has reached 200 points.
Round score: add the values of your Number cards (the 0 card is worth 0).
If you have the x2 modifier, double the sum of your Number cards first, then add the +2 to +10 modifiers.
+2, +4, +6, +8, +10 Modifier cards add the shown amount to the round score.
Flip 7: having seven unique face-up Number cards scores an additional 15 bonus points.
A player who busts scores 0 for the round; players who Stay or Freeze bank their round points.
Next round: set all cards from the round aside without shuffling them into the deck; pass the remaining deck to the left, and that player becomes the new Dealer.
When the deck runs out, shuffle all discarded cards to form a new deck; if reshuffling mid-round, leave cards in front of players where they are, even busted players' cards.
When the game ends, the player with the most points wins.
Number cards: the number of copies equals the card's value (twelve 12s down to one 1) plus a single 0.
With more than 18 players, use a second deck.
